column1: # contributor-manifest.tsv — the tracked registry of session-start
# CONTRIBUTORS (temperloop#827, epic #810's sub-item "P1" — epic #810's OWN
# numbering for its Produces list, e.g. "P1"/"P7"/"P9", is a DIFFERENT axis
# from docs/adr/0018-measure-session-cost-before-gating.md's Phase A/Phase B
# split of the SAME epic: every P-numbered item below belongs to Phase A:
# nothing here is Phase B. Design brief:
# [[Designs/temperloop - session-start context budget]]): every file, or
# file's frontmatter `description:` field, that Claude Code auto-loads into
# a fresh session's context BEFORE the agent reads anything, for a BARE
# kernel-only checkout — no overlay installed, no composed CLAUDE.md written
# at all (a real `temperloop install --yes` on a kernel-only clone writes 24
# managed paths and ZERO composed `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` — `links_enumerate()`
# emits the compose target only when both kernel and overlay files exist).
# For THIS checkout, the always-loaded surface a stranger actually pays for
# IS this manifest — not claude/CLAUDE.kernel.md's composed render, which is
# workflows/scripts/count-prose.sh's separate TIER-1 concern (the render an
# overlay-carrying DOWNSTREAM consumer, e.g. foundation, would compose).
# ── COVERAGE CLAIM, stated in checkable terms (temperloop#826) ────────────
# This manifest, together with TIER-1, covers 100% of a KERNEL-ONLY
# checkout's always-loaded surface and 0% of a CONSUMER checkout's (a
# downstream repo with an installed overlay + its own project `CLAUDE.md` —
# e.g. foundation). Read no further sentence in this file as implying
# otherwise: "the render an overlay-carrying downstream consumer would
# compose" (above) names WHERE that content lives, not a claim that this
# manifest or TIER-1 measures it. DO NOT READ the
# "SESSION-START CONTRIBUTOR TOTAL" line count-prose.sh prints below as a
# consumer checkout's session cost — it is off by roughly an order of
# magnitude for that case (the always-loaded overlay + project `CLAUDE.md`
# are entirely uncounted here). A consumer-side measurement is future work,
# not yet built.
# This file is read by count-prose.sh's "SESSION-START CONTRIBUTORS" report
# section and reconciled by workflows/scripts/config/
# check-contributor-manifest.sh (wired into scripts/quality-gates.sh).
# Adding a contributor is a ROW, never a code change (temperloop#827
# acceptance 2) — the extraction MODE (column 2) is itself data, so a new
# contributor category needs no new count-prose.sh logic as long as its
# unit already exists below.
# ── Two distinct load classes (temperloop#826 coverage spike, empirically
# "Session-start" is not one thing. The spike's scratch-dir probe (four
# uniquely-marked files, a tool-free session asked which markers were in its
# auto-loaded context) found `CLAUDE.md` / `.claude/CLAUDE.md` /
# `CLAUDE.local.md` present but `AGENTS.md` ABSENT from the harness's own
# auto-load — `AGENTS.md` instead enters on turn 1, because the auto-loaded
# root `CLAUDE.md`'s own instruction 1 says "Read AGENTS.md first". Column 4
# (`load`) below exists so this split never requires a schema migration:
# summing a `pointer-turn1` row into the same total as a `harness-auto` row
# would produce a number that moves without the underlying cost moving —
# the exact metric error ADR 0018 was written against, reintroduced inside
# the epic correcting it. Every row THIS item adds is `harness-auto` (the
# unconditional prefix cost) — count-prose.sh's report buckets its
# byte→token ratio over the `harness-auto` bucket only, for exactly this
# reason. Emitting turn-1 rows (e.g. AGENTS.md, once temperloop#810's P7 —
# the "AGENTS.md coverage decision" sub-item — rules on it) is routed to
# temperloop#836 (turn-1 contributor rows, e.g. AGENTS.md) — explicitly NOT
# this item's job, only a schema this item must not block.
# TAB-separated, 4 columns, no header line consumed by tooling (this comment
# block documents them):
#   1. path    repo-relative TRACKED path. check-contributor-manifest.sh
#              verifies every row's path is a real `git ls-files` entry —
#              this is what structurally keeps a HOST-STATE contributor
#              (e.g. the machine-global ~/.claude/agents surface, which
#              varies per machine/operator and would break the
#              byte-identical-on-macOS-and-Linux-CI determinism contract
#              outright) out of the manifest: a path outside this repo's
#              own tracked tree can never satisfy the check.
#   2. unit    extraction unit, one of:
#                full                     the whole tracked file's bytes.
#                frontmatter:description  ONLY the YAML frontmatter
#                                          `description:` scalar's value
#                                          bytes (single-line, unquoted,
#                                          no folding — true of every row
#                                          below; check-contributor-
#                                          manifest.sh fails loudly if a
#                                          future edit breaks this
#                                          assumption for any row's file).
#                                          Deliberately NOT the whole file:
#                                          Claude Code's own command/agent
#                                          listing surfaces only this one
#                                          frontmatter field at session
#                                          start, never the body. (Summing
#                                          every frontmatter:description row
#                                          below plus the one `full` row
#                                          reconciles to the design brief's
#                                          own reconciled ~14.1 KB / ~5.2k-
#                                          token stranger footprint.)
#   3. label   contributor category, for report grouping (free text, no
#              tabs): kernel-pointer | command-listing | agent-listing.
#   4. load    which load class this row belongs to (closed set):
#                harness-auto    arrives unconditionally before the operator
#                                types anything — the harness's own
#                                auto-load (verified set: CLAUDE.md, the
#                                composed ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md,
#                                CLAUDE.local.md, plus the command/agent
#                                listings every row below belongs to).
#                pointer-turn1   arrives only if the agent complies with a
#                                read instruction another already-loaded
#                                file gives it (AGENTS.md's own class — not
#                                used by any row in this item; reserved for
#                                temperloop#836).
#                none            a deliberate-absence row recording that a
#                                candidate path is NOT a contributor at all
#                                (reserved; not used by any row in this
#                                item).
#                n/a             the load-class question does not apply to
#                                this row (reserved; not used by any row in
#                                this item).
# ── Invariants (check-contributor-manifest.sh) ───────────────────────────
#   - No path claimed by two rows.
#   - Every row's path is git-tracked (`git ls-files`).
#   - unit is one of the closed set named above.
#   - load is one of the closed set named above.
#   - A frontmatter:description row's file actually carries that field.
#   - COMPLETENESS: every tracked claude/commands/*.md file, and every
#     tracked claude/agents/**/*.md file (recursive — INCLUDING
#     claude/agents/reviewers/*), has a row. The reviewers ARE included
#     deliberately: temperloop#825's discovery-leak bug means these seven
#     inert-catalog files are, today, recursively discovered into every
#     session's agent listing despite being specified as "not deployed
#     until opted in" — P1 measures the surface as it actually behaves, bug
#     included; #825 removes these rows once the leak is fixed, not this
#     item. The root CLAUDE.md pointer has a row too (unit `full`).
#   - claude/CLAUDE.kernel.md itself — TIER-1's concern (the composed
#     render), never auto-loaded verbatim in a kernel-only checkout.
#   - AGENTS.md — temperloop#810 P7's own open disposition ("counted or
#     explicitly scoped out — not silently uncounted"); this item does not
#     decide it, so it stays out of this manifest until P7 lands its call
#     (it would be a `pointer-turn1` row per the load-class note above, not
#     `harness-auto`, so it must never be added as one more row summed into
#     the same bucket as the rows below).
#   - the machine-global ~/.claude/agents surface — HOST STATE (varies by
#     machine/operator); structurally excluded by the tracked-path
#     invariant above, never a special case in the checker.
